text: The Scorpio group of companies is headquartered in Monaco, has been investing in and operating shipping assets for over 70 years, and is carried forward by its chairman Emanuele A. Lauro, a fourth-generation member of the Lolli-Ghetti family.
short: Scorpio Group is a private Monaco shipping group led by Emanuele A. Lauro of the Lolli-Ghetti family.

source.name: Scorpio Group, 'About us / Our History'
source.quote: The Scorpio group of companies (Scorpio) is headquartered in Monaco and has been investing in and operating shipping assets for over 70 years

additionalSources.name: Sabah FK, '“Sabah” FK “Scorpio Group”la sponsorluq müqaviləsi imzalayıb'
additionalSources.quote: Baş ofisi Monakoda yerləşən “Scorpio Group” dəniz nəqliyyatı və gəmiçilik sahəsində fəaliyyət göstərən beynəlxalq şirkətlər qrupudur
additionalSources.note: The club's own announcement independently describes Scorpio Group as an international group of companies headquartered in Monaco operating in maritime transport and shipping; it names no state owner.
